div.span:
Inputs
Raw session directory
TIFF/OME-TIFF movies, voltage CSV, optional Bpod .mat

Job generation
python -m utils_2p.processing_pipeline submit|generate
Writes manifest.json, stage .sbatch files, submit_jobs.sh, and logs

1. Prep
run_stage(..., stage='prep')
_run_prep(data, session)
Creates raw_voltages.h5, copies bpod_session_data.mat, writes provenance JSON

2. Suite2p
run_stage(..., stage='suite2p')
_run_suite2p(data, session)
suite2p.run_s2p(ops=ops, db=db)
Writes suite2p/plane0/ops.npy, stat.npy, F.npy, Fneu.npy, iscell.npy, spks.npy

3. dF/F
run_stage(..., stage='dff')
_run_dff(data, session)
dff_traces.run(ops, normalize=False, correct_pmt=False)
Reads native suite2p/plane0/F.npy and Fneu.npy; writes dff.h5

4. Summary and interactive reviewer
run_stage(..., stage='summary')
_run_summary(data, session)
create_processing_summary(session['output_path'], input_layout='suite2p')
Writes the processing PDF and interactive ROI reviewer HTML

Reviewer exports and downstream use
roi_manual_labels.npy, QC threshold JSON, ROI metric CSV
Downstream analysis applies ROI-indexed label/filter masks

ROI model scores
optional: --run-roi-model-scores
_run_roi_model_scores(data, session)
roi_model_scores.run(session['output_path'], model_path=...)
Currently only for cerebellar dendrite ROIs
Writes roi_model_scores.h5; may update ROI_label.h5

Cell-type label
optional: --run-label
_run_label(data, session)
LabelExcInh.run(ops, diameter=6)
Writes masks.h5

Inferred spikes
optional: --run-oasis
_run_spikes(data, session)
oasis_spikes.run(ops, tau=oasis_tau, event_threshold=...)
Writes spikes.h5
